## Description

Supersedes the SQL parts of MDV-P0-006, 008, 009 and 019. One Flexible Server per country (Central or South India first), private endpoint only, Entra-only authentication with managed identities, customer-managed key for storage, zone-redundant HA and PITR kept in-country, logs to the country workspace, Azure Policy denying other regions, and a timed restore drill.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the Bicep, when it deploys, then the server has no public endpoint and password login is off.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a restore drill, when it runs, then point-in-time restore completes within the agreed time and is timed in the runbook.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a resource, when is created outside the allowed regions, then policy denies it.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
